description: Na₂CrO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmcm space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O²⁻ atoms. There are two shorter (2.28 Å) and two longer (2.46 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CrO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are two shorter (2.32 Å) and four longer (2.39 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Cr⁶⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form CrO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-52°. There are two shorter (1.64 Å) and two longer (1.66 Å) Cr-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na¹⁺ and one Cr⁶⁺ atom. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na¹⁺ and one Cr⁶⁺ atom.
